description: Finds the Printdash products that match the customer's words ("A5 flyers", "round stickers", "pull up banner"), best first. Returns ids for get_product, each with the site's from_price (a starting price; price_job gives the exact one). Printdash prints in Australia and delivers within Australia only; prices are in AUD and include GST.

query.description: The customer's words for what they want printed.

name: search_products

priced_at.description: When Printdash's pricing service priced it for the site.

quantity.description: How many the starting price is for.

source.description: site: the figure printdash.io publishes now; bundled: the same figure as of Printdash's last server update.

total_inc_gst.description: AUD including GST, public retail, for the product's default_configuration at quantity.

from_price.description: The starting price the Printdash site shows for this product ("From $X inc GST for N"). A guide only: price_job gives the exact price. Null when none is published.

title: Search Printdash products
